title: DeepFacts charts pan-India expansion for AI remote patient monitoring platform proRITHM
summary: HealthTech company plans expansion across four states before entering the US market, while advancing AI-enabled remote patient monitoring
contentHtml:
HealthTech company plans expansion across four states before entering the US market, while advancing AI-enabled remote patient monitoring

DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd., the HealthTech company behind proRITHM, has announced its expansion roadmap, with plans to strengthen its presence across Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Odisha before expanding across India by early 2027. The company already has a presence in Telangana and is preparing to enter the US market by late 2027 or early 2028 as it scales its AI-enabled healthcare solutions.

Designed to support continuous patient monitoring, DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd. combines wearable technology with artificial intelligence to enable early health risk detection and remote clinical monitoring. The platform allows healthcare providers to monitor vital health parameters in real time.

As part of its technology development efforts, DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd. has secured three granted patents, reinforcing its focus on developing proprietary healthcare technologies.

Commenting on the company’s growth plans, Vamsi Karatam, Founder & CEO, DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd., said; “The future of healthcare lies in continuous, intelligent monitoring that enables timely interventions rather than reactive treatment. Our focus is to make clinically reliable remote monitoring accessible to healthcare providers across India while building globally relevant technology. The next phase of our expansion is centred on strengthening our presence in key Indian markets, deepening collaborations with healthcare partners, and preparing for international expansion.”

DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd. has also received recognition through national programmes and government-backed initiatives. The company was selected among the Top 4 AI-based Healthcare Technologies at the AI in Healthcare 2.0 International Conference organised by Yashoda Hospitals and RICH. It was also the second runner-up in the AP MedTech Challenge, organised by the Government of Andhra Pradesh and RTIH, under the Remote Care and Telemedicine category.

The company is also recognised and supported by TIH, IIT Bombay, DRISHI CPS Foundation, IIT Indore and GHRTBIF.

With a growing intellectual property portfolio, expanding collaborations with healthcare providers and a roadmap for domestic and international growth, DeepFacts Pvt. Ltd. aims to accelerate the adoption of proRITHM, its AI-powered remote patient monitoring platform, while contributing to healthcare accessibility and patient outcomes.
